source.title: Heart Failure Disparities in Medicare Fee-For-Service Beneficiaries
source.location: Page 1: MMD Tool indicates 12% of Medicare FFS had heart failure in 2022; Figure 1 age 65+ stratum also ~12%
source.citation: CMS Office of Minority Health. Data Snapshot: Heart Failure Disparities in Medicare FFS (January 2024).

population.enrollment_notes: Source MMD FFS prevalence; 2022 flagged preliminary in snapshot footnotes.

cohort.inclusion_notes: National FFS HF prevalence; MVP execution uses age ≥65 Option B filters.

result.notes: Published 12% Medicare FFS HF prevalence (2022 MMD; preliminary).

governance.rationale: Accepted as calibration target #2 (HF prevalence) for mvp corpus v1.
conflicts: CMS-AGG-05 documents 2017 HF 14.4% (27-CCW) vs 12.1% (30-CCW); algorithm family dominates level.
